title: Home page
content:
Chemistry that finally clicks.

Small-group SQA Chemistry tuition with Lynsey Robinson — over 20 years teaching National 5, Higher and Advanced Higher, and an SQA marker who knows exactly what examiners look for.

A qualified teacher who knows the Scottish curriculum inside out

I've spent more than 20 years teaching Chemistry in the classroom, at every level from National 5 through to Advanced Higher. I also mark for the SQA, so I know precisely how marks are awarded — and where pupils quietly lose them.

Alongside teaching I've been a pastoral care teacher, supporting young people through exam stress, mental health and career choices. I'm a mum myself, so I understand the highs and lows of exams from both sides.

  • Fully qualified teacher · GTCS registered
  • PVG certified — happy to share on request
  • Fully insured — tutor insurance in place
  • SQA marker — exam technique is my speciality
  • Inclusive, patient and adaptable — including ASN & autism support

"I had a pupil who was told he shouldn't sit the N5 Chemistry exam a few weeks before. We worked hard together to prepare — and he passed."

Every SQA Chemistry level, properly covered

Small group classes of no more than eight pupils — enough for discussion and shared learning, small enough that nobody hides at the back.

National 5

Building strong foundations and confidence for the N5 exam.

  • Chemical changes & structure
  • Nature's chemistry
  • Chemistry in society
  • Past-paper technique & open-ended questions

More on National 5 Chemistry →

Higher

Bridging the big jump from N5 — the step most pupils find hardest.

  • Chemical changes & structure
  • Nature's chemistry & researching chemistry
  • Calculations and problem solving
  • Past-paper technique & open-ended questions

More on Higher Chemistry →

Advanced Higher

Depth, rigour and university-ready problem solving.

  • Inorganic & physical chemistry
  • Organic chemistry & instrumental analysis
  • Researching chemistry & the project
  • Higher-order exam techniques

More on Advanced Higher Chemistry →

Included in every course

  • Revision materials for every topic on the course
  • Quizzes to check understanding as you go
  • Assessments under exam conditions
  • A weekly assessment, with feedback sent to parents

All of it is included in the price — there is nothing extra to buy.

Prices vary by course and group — enquire for current rates.

Small groups. Real progress. No pressure.

Maximum 8 pupils

Small enough that every pupil gets attention and feels comfortable asking questions — never lost in a class of thirty.

Live online classes

Live Zoom sessions with interactive whiteboards, quizzes and polls — so your child can join from anywhere in Scotland.

Past papers, every week

Constant exam practice so pupils recognise question types, command words and exactly how to secure the marks.

Parent feedback

Clear updates on where your child is now, what's improving and what still needs work — communication parents actually get.

Inclusive & supportive

Teaching adapted to suit each pupil, including additional support needs — patient, friendly and genuinely encouraging.

Exam technique focus

As an SQA marker, I teach pupils to answer the way examiners want — often the fastest route to a better grade.

Chemistry tuition across the whole of Scotland

Based in Glasgow and teaching pupils from the Borders to Shetland. Live online small-group classes mean wherever you are in Scotland — city, town or island — expert SQA Chemistry tuition is available.

Anywhere in Scotland

Live online classes on Zoom with interactive whiteboards, quizzes and polls — identical teaching whether you're in Glasgow or Stornoway.

Small groups only

Every class is capped at eight pupils, so your child is never lost in a crowd and always has room to ask.

SQA curriculum only

National 5, Higher and Advanced Higher Chemistry — the Scottish curriculum, taught by a Scottish teacher and SQA marker.

33 towns and cities, from Glasgow to Lerwick.
